title: Verify E170 source-boundary read composition
changes: Exercise bus and native API read-width composition at every distinct source boundary in the E170 manifest with altered backing ROM.
validation: Windows GNU build e170-all-source-boundaries-build-daq6ns_h and Wine e170-all-source-boundaries-wine-yeg0bdt_ pass 445,350 probes across all 74,225 distinct boundaries of 54,792 source spans and mirrors 08/0a/0c. Halfword and word results match byte composition; the range owner serves 96 bytes. Inputs protected, scratch removed and Wine drained.
limitations: Boundary samples use no guest execution and do not establish every source byte, ordinary usage or timing. Byte-origin counts include repeated observations and are not resource ownership attribution; both managed and raw backing values are expected. Linux, USA, native Windows and performance remain deferred.
